profile.headline: Software Engineer IV at Myriad Genetics
profile.summary:
I’m a software engineer and technical leader with deep experience building, modernizing, and supporting complex Java applications and distributed systems.

My work spans Java, Spring Boot, microservices, event-driven architectures, APIs, enterprise integrations, and cloud technologies. I enjoy solving difficult technical problems, improving architecture and engineering practices, and helping other developers succeed.

I’ve led modernization efforts, improved testing and production support, mentored engineers, and provided technical leadership while remaining hands-on with development.

positions.title: Software Engineer IV
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
positions.description:
Senior Java Developer responsible for back end microservices written in Java Spring Boot that connect to Kafka and Rabbit and store data in OracleSQL, PostgreSQL, and Salesforce to ensure patient orders are processed and saved. These services provide both Rest and GraphQL endpoints. 

Other skills used in this position include: Thymeleaf, JPA, Okta Authentication integration.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Team lead and developer responsible for customer product integration into ICE Software with MySQL data handling. Developed new features and Swing UI interfaces for customer tailored functionality. Implemented 2D, 3D, and AutoCAD visual representations of product. Implemented XML, CSV, and PDF export functionality to generate manufacturing data output. Added ability to export data to Salesforce using REST. Worked directly with the customers to design functionality and manage tasks in fast agile environment. Worked on project to Modularize ICE core codebase. Added testing infrastructure to core ICE to make it possible for developers to add integration level testing to the automated test system.

positions.title: Senior Java Developer
positions.description:
Senior Java Developer responsible for developing services to communicate between the Waterford Early Learning student client application and Waterford Early Learning teacher manager. Corrected bugs in existing student activities.  Converted legacy Java Swing and Video based applications to GWT for a future web version of the student client application. 

Worked within Agile (Scrum) process to size and work on stories and tasks. Used Maven, Spring, Glassfish, GWT, Java Web Start, and Postgres tools while working on Waterford Early Learning products. 

Wrote JUnit based integration level and unit level tests for new Waterford Early Learning services. Used Selenium to write tests for the Waterford Early Learning manager.

positions.title: Java Swing Guru (Senior Software Engineer)
positions.description:
Sept 2007-June 2008
Feb 2009 - July 2010

Team lead and developer responsible for all parts of the Shazzle User Interface. Shazzle is a real-time peer-to-peer multithreaded desktop file sharing application with social networking aspects. The user interface was well underway when I joined the company and I joined Shazzle with responsibility to clean up the UI and add new features such as docking/undocking, user profiles, preferences along with many other features. In addition, I was responsible for coordinating UI development work with three junior developers located in Tashkent, Ukraine. This was a 100% telecommuting position.

Technologies used: Swing, SWT, GWT, and Hibernate.

positions.title: Senior Developer and Head of Quality Assurance
positions.description: As Head of Quality Assurance I was responsible for designing and implementing an automated quality assurance plan throughout the company’s development process, writing interactive test plans, writing unit tests, mentoring and monitoring developers to promote and ensure comprehensive unit testing and general leadership and ownership of the company’s quality assurance efforts to promote the highest standards. In addition, as Senior Developer, I was responsible for developing software applications for web, wireless and other networked media in PHP, AJAX, CSS, HTML, Javascript (and JQuery), and Objective C for iPhone Application development.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Java Software Engineer with experience in Java, UI design, programming language design, and library/API design, specializing in Java Swing and XML. As a member of the MATLAB Desktop team, I was responsible for development of the MATLAB Command Window, Command History, File Browser, Find tools, and Shortcuts.  I developed multi-platform, multi-threaded desktop applications that have been used by millions of customers.

Java, C/C++, Perl
WIndows, Linux, Solaris, Mac

I also worked at the MathWorks as a Quality Engineer for 1 year before moving into development.

Patent: 7631168 Graphical interface for grouping concurrent computing units executing a concurrent computing process

Patent: 9069517 Graphical interface for monitoring the status of concurrent computing units executing a concurrent computing process 

Patent: 9405564 System and method for targeting commands to concurrent computing units executing a concurrent computing process

positions.title: TLP Engineer
positions.description: As part of the Technical Leadership Program, I worked in the Heat Transfer division.  Used PATRAN to model and evaluate the performance and heat transfer characteristics of next generation jet engine parts.  At the same time I attended Master’s level classes in all areas of Mechanical Engineering.

positions.title: Quality Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Qualified functionality of the new compiler (2.0)  for MATLAB.  Created new tests for the MATLAB Compiler for sparse and struct datatypes and converted tests for the math libraries from an old testing format to a new testing format.  Completed test suites for varargin/nargin, load/save, and indexing.  Validated MATLAB 5.2 release for the VMS platform and qualified the installer for the VMS.

June 1998-September 1998
January 1998 – March 1998

positions.title: Lab Technician Intern
positions.description:
Prepared and fabricated superconducting strand samples for heat-treatment and testing in a high field superconducting magnet.  Monitored the heat treatment process of superconducting strand samples.  Assembled Hall Probes for the Magnetic Field Mapping project.   Photographed samples in an electron microscope used to evaluate the integrity of new fabrication processes for superconductors.  Assisted in research that led to numerous publications on currents in twisted multifilamentary superconducting wires.

June 1996 - December 1996
March 1997 - June 1997
